stories.headline: OpenAI is cutting off Cursor after SpaceX bought it for $60B
stories.blurb: OpenAI will stop letting Cursor access its models on Nov. 12, weeks after Elon Musk's SpaceX acquired the AI coding tool for $60 billion. OpenAI cited concerns about the acquisition but didn't specify what those concerns are.
stories.why_it_matters: The split shows how quickly AI partnerships can unravel when competitors change hands.
stories.original_headline: OpenAI to end model access to Cursor after acquisition by Elon Musk's SpaceX

stories.headline: Nvidia's profit doubles to $60 billion as AI spending keeps surging
stories.blurb: Nvidia reported quarterly revenue of $96.22 billion — more than double last year — driven by continued demand for AI chips from cloud providers and enterprises. The profit beat Wall Street expectations as data center buildouts show no signs of slowing.
stories.why_it_matters: The AI infrastructure boom isn't slowing down yet, and Nvidia remains the main beneficiary.
stories.original_headline: Nvidia’s Profit Doubles to $59.69 Billion Thanks to A.I. Spending

stories.headline: Photoshop is getting an AI-only interface you can toggle on
stories.blurb: Adobe's rolling out a beta view that puts all of Photoshop's AI tools—prompt-based editing, background removal, image extension—in one dedicated toolbar. It's optional, so you can flip between the classic interface and the AI-focused one depending on what you're building.
stories.why_it_matters: Photoshop is splitting into two modes: traditional and AI-first
stories.original_headline: Adobe is adding more AI to Photoshop

stories.headline: Google Search can now book your entire trip in AI Mode
stories.blurb: Google added three features to AI Mode in Search: you can now get full itineraries with restaurant and activity recommendations, compare flight and hotel options side-by-side with live pricing, and book directly without leaving the results page. It's rolling out in the US first, with hotels bookable through Google's travel partners.
stories.why_it_matters: Search is becoming the actual booking agent, not just the research tool.
stories.original_headline: 3 new ways to plan and book travel in Search

try_this_prompt.title: The negotiation floor
try_this_prompt.prompt: I'm about to negotiate something I'll describe below. Don't give me tactics or scripts. Instead: tell me the worst deal I should still accept, the number where I should walk away completely, and the one thing I'm probably overvaluing that the other side doesn't care about.
try_this_prompt.tool_hint: Before any salary, vendor, or partnership conversation where you might say yes to something you'll regret.
